# jsQR (vendored)

QR code reader used only by the editor's "QR-Code aus Bild lesen" (Wi-Fi networks): it reads the `WIFI:` code from a
photo of a router sticker or a printed guest Wi-Fi card, in the browser. It lives in the editor's lazily loaded chunk,
never in the card's entry file.

- Origin: npm package `jsqr` 1.4.0, file `dist/jsQR.js` (unchanged), types `jsQR.d.ts` from `dist/index.d.ts` (trimmed to one file)
